alert.title: orders 5xx 18% — DNS resolution failures across services

tool_calls.result_summary: many services in ERROR/WARN simultaneously: orders, checkout, search, cart
21 ERROR lines: EAI_AGAIN getaddrinfo on internal hostnames
1 config rollout 12 min before alert: coredns ConfigMap update

hypotheses.reasoning: Multiple unrelated services hit error simultaneously with the same EAI_AGAIN signature — the common dependency is internal DNS, not application code. A coredns ConfigMap rollout landed 12 minutes before the alert. The pattern is a DNS plane regression cascading downstream to anyone resolving internal hostnames.

evidence.claim: orders, checkout, search, cart degraded simultaneously
21 ERROR lines on orders: EAI_AGAIN getaddrinfo internal hostnames
9 matching ERROR lines on checkout — same EAI_AGAIN signature
coredns ConfigMap rolled out 12 min before alert

hypotheses.recommended_action: Roll back the coredns ConfigMap; see runbooks/internal-dns.md. Keep app rollbacks queued only if DNS rollback does not resolve in 5 min.

hypotheses.reasoning: orders is the alerting service but its code is unchanged. The simultaneous failure across unrelated services rules out an orders-specific regression.

evidence.claim: no deploys to orders in last 24h
errors share signature with checkout, ruling out orders-specific bug

hypotheses.reasoning: An external provider could in theory fail simultaneously, but EAI_AGAIN is a DNS-plane error, not an HTTP/network error.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Inspect provider status only if DNS rollback does not resolve.

escalation.reason: Multi-service blast radius; recommend page platform on-call in parallel with rollback.
